school: 曼彻斯特省城学会的定量化学（以五十七年气象日志为地基、以相对原子量为原子论发身份证、以学会宣读为学术制度——把两千年哲学思辨逼成可称可数的数字，用简朴与教学供养一个没有先例的科学人生）
historical_significance: 约翰·道尔顿（John Dalton, 1766-1844），坎伯兰织工之子、贵格会教徒，几乎未受正规高等教育，从乡村学校教师起步；21 岁起每日记录气象直至去世前一天（约五十七年、二十万条），由此进入大气研究；1794 年发表首篇色盲系统研究（后世'道尔顿症'以他命名），并立遗嘱要求解剖自己的眼睛验证假设；1801-1802 年提出分压定律与蒸发研究；1803 年发表首张相对原子量表（以氢=1），同年发现倍比定律——同一两种元素的多种化合物其重量比成简单整数比，为'物质由不可分原子构成'提供第一份定量证据；1808 年出版《化学哲学新体系》，系统奠定原子学说：元素由同种原子构成、化合物以固定整数比例结合、化学反应是原子的重新组合。他一生没有大学教授职位，以教书、私授与曼彻斯特文学与哲学学会（116 篇论文、后任终身会长）为制度支点，拒绝迁往伦敦；1822 年当选皇家学会会员、1826 年获首届皇家奖章、1830 年入选法国科学院外籍院士；1844 年去世时曼彻斯特约四万人送葬，'道尔顿'（Da）后来成为分子量的计量单位。他把两千年前的德谟克利特猜想变成了可检验的定量科学，是化学从手艺走向科学的转折点。
historical_significance_en: John Dalton (1766-1844), a Cumberland weaver's son and Quaker with almost no formal higher education, began as a village schoolmaster; from twenty-one he kept a weather log every day until the day before his death (some fifty-seven years, two hundred thousand entries), which led him into the study of the air. In 1794 he published the first systematic study of color blindness (daltonism named for him), willing his own eyes to dissection to test his hypothesis. In 1801-02 came the law of partial pressures and the evaporation studies; in 1803 the first table of relative atomic weights (hydrogen = 1) and the law of multiple proportions — the weight ratios of two elements' several compounds standing in simple whole numbers, the first quantitative evidence that matter is built of indivisible atoms. A New System of Chemical Philosophy (1808) laid atomism out in full: elements of like atoms, compounds in fixed integral combination, chemical reaction the regrouping of atoms. He never held a university professorship; teaching, private pupils and the Manchester Literary and Philosophical Society (116 papers, lifelong president) were his institutional fulcrum, and he refused to move to London. FRS in 1822, the first Royal Medal in 1826, foreign associate of the French Academy in 1830; when he died in 1844 some forty thousand Mancunians followed the coffin, and the dalton (Da) became the unit of molecular mass. He turned Democritus's two-thousand-year guess into testable quantitative science — the turning point at which chemistry became a science.
unique_thinking: 道尔顿思维模式的独特性在于四条主线的合成：第一，'把异常当课题'——从自己的色盲到气体混合的怪性质，他不修正异常而登记异常，私人缺陷在他手里变成公共科学；第二，'给旧概念发身份证'——原子论两千年停在哲学，他不另起新说，而是逼它产出数字（原子量、整数比），哲学概念第一次获得可检验的身份；第三，'复利式记录'——五十七年气象日志证明没有大问题的年代可以把观测本身存成理论的期权，分压定律直接从台账里长出来；第四，'制度自造'——没有大学教授职位就把省城学会经营成大学、实验室与出版社，没有'化学家'这个职业就以每日记录、每月宣读、每周授课把身份活成现实。他的假设方法论同样自成一格：最大简比原则明示为假设、坦然被修正（氧从 8 到 16），'先定量、后修正'的路线使后来者有数可改——他宁可给出可错的第一版，也不给出不可错的空谈。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Dalton's thinking is a synthesis of four lines. First, anomaly as topic: from his own color blindness to the odd behavior of mixed gases, he registered anomalies rather than correcting them away, turning private defects into public science. Second, issuing old concepts their papers: atomism stood two millennia as philosophy; he forced it to yield numbers — atomic weights, whole-number ratios — the philosophical concept first gaining a testable identity. Third, compound-interest records: the fifty-seven-year weather log proved that years without great questions can bank observation itself as theory's option, the law of partial pressures growing straight out of the ledger. Fourth, self-made institutions: no professorship, so he ran a provincial society as university, laboratory and press; no such profession as chemist, so he lived it into being with the daily record, the monthly reading, the weekly lesson. His method of assumption is equally its own: the rule of greatest simplicity stated as assumption and calmly revised (oxygen from 8 to 16) — quantify first, revise later gave successors numbers to correct; he preferred a fallible first edition to an infallible emptiness.
civilization_zh: 18世纪末至19世纪中的英国工业革命心脏地带——坎伯兰织工家庭与贵格会灰衣，曼彻斯特的棉厂、运河与新起的文学与哲学学会：一个没有大学文凭的教书匠在省城的会议室里给两千年的原子论称出重量，'化学家'尚未成为职业，他先把这种身份活成了现实
civilization_en: Britain's industrial heartland from the late eighteenth to the mid-nineteenth century — a Cumberland weaver's family and the Quaker grey, Manchester's mills, canals and new Literary and Philosophical Society: a schoolmaster without a degree weighing two millennia of atomism in a provincial meeting room, before 'chemist' was a profession, living the identity into being

Teacher of mathematics and natural philosophy

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与牛顿同为'让自然交出数字'的大师，而起点相反：牛顿从现象上行到普遍引力定律，再以定律统一天上地下；道尔顿从两千年前的哲学猜想下行到实验室的称量，以数字反推概念——两人都相信'自然之书用数学写成'，都为自己发明了所需的工具（流数法/原子量表），都不允许'说得通'替代'算得出'。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Newton are both masters of making nature surrender numbers, from opposite starts: Newton rose from phenomena to universal gravitation and unified heaven and earth by it; Dalton descended from a two-thousand-old philosophical conjecture to the laboratory balance, inferring concepts from numbers — both believed the book of nature written in mathematics, both invented the tools they needed (fluxions, the atomic-weight table), and both refused to let 'plausible' stand in for 'computable'.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与达尔文同是'慢数据养出大学说'的典范：道尔顿五十七年气象日志养出原子论，达尔文二十年积累养出物种起源——两人都在没有大问题的年代坚持记录，都把'长期台账'当作理论的期权，都在数据复利到临界点时一举提现；两人也都以谦虚的文风包装锋利的主张。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Darwin are alike exemplars of slow data raising great theory: fifty-seven years of weather logs raising atomism, twenty years of accumulation raising the Origin — both kept records through years when no great question offered, both held the long ledger as theory's option, both cashed in at the moment the data compounded past threshold; both wrapped sharp claims in modest prose.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与爱因斯坦代表定标科学的两极：爱因斯坦以思想实验重构已有概念的根基（同时性、引力），几乎不进实验室；道尔顿以称量与计数给尚无根基的概念（原子）造出第一版数值身份——一个证明'概念批判可以走在测量之前'，一个证明'测量可以走在概念澄清之前'；原子论的最终形态（阿伏伽德罗-坎尼扎罗标准）证明两条路线缺一不可。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Einstein are the two poles of calibration science: Einstein restructured the foundations of given concepts — simultaneity, gravitation — by thought experiment, hardly entering a laboratory; Dalton weighed and counted a rootless concept, the atom, into its first numerical identity — one proved conceptual critique can precede measurement, the other that measurement can precede conceptual clarification; the final form of atomism (the Avogadro-Cannizzaro standard) proved both routes indispensable.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与麦克林托克同是'在自己的异常感知上建立学派'的人：麦克林托克在玉米地里看见别人看不见的转座子、冷落三十年而不改；道尔顿在自家眼睛里发现别人看不见的色盲、把它做成一门研究——两人都信任'我看见的与教科书不同'这一事实，都以独自的长期观察对抗学界的定见，最终都被时间完全证实。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and McClintock are alike in founding a science on their own anomalous perception: she saw in the maize field transposons no one else saw and held for thirty years unshaken; he found in his own eyes a color blindness no one else perceived and made it a study — both trusted the fact that what they saw differed from the textbook, both met the learned world's settled opinion with solitary long observation, and both were wholly vindicated by time.

modes.name_en: The Method of Dissecting One's Own Eye
modes.category: 方法论/从自身异常出发
modes.domain_zh: 他和兄弟都把红色看成别的颜色——别人当它是怪癖，他却把自己的眼睛当成第一个研究对象：追问'我看见的绯红，别人看见的是什么'，再以家族、以人群为样本把私人感觉变成公共事实——第一次把'色盲'从奇闻上升为可遗传、可分类、可命名的科学现象；道尔顿证明：研究者身上最'不方便'的缺陷，往往就是离他最近的未开垦的问题
modes.domain_en: He and his brother both saw red as other colors do not — others called it a quirk; he made his own eye the first object of study: asking what the scarlet I see is to others, then using his family and the public as samples to turn a private sensation into a public fact — the first raising of 'color blindness' from anecdote to a heritable, classifiable, nameable phenomenon; Dalton proved that a researcher's most inconvenient defect is often the untilled problem lying closest to him
modes.source_chapter: 约翰·道尔顿（John Dalton, 1766-1844），坎伯兰织工家庭出身，贵格会教徒；他与兄长乔纳森均患色觉异常，1790 年代在肯德尔与曼彻斯特做气象与光学研究时注意到自己的感知与常人不合：有时把绯红认作橄榄绿、把粉色认作蓝色；1794 年发表《关于颜色知觉的非凡事实》（Extraordinary facts relating to the vision of colours），首次系统描述'色盲'（后世称道尔顿症 daltonism），记录自己与兄弟的病例、调查家族谱系并提出遗传解释——他还立遗嘱指示死后解剖自己的眼睛以验证其假设（眼内液体是否带蓝色吸收层）；1844 年去世后解剖发现晶状体正常，现代 DNA 检测于 1990 年代证实他患的是最常见的 deuteranopia（绿色盲）——自我假设错了一半，但问题与方法对了
modes.key_quote_zh: 这毛病从我出生起就跟着我——那就从我这双眼睛开始研究
modes.key_quote_en: "This infirmity has followed me from birth — then let it be studied, beginning with my own eyes."
process_zh: 承认异常而非遮掩：发现自己'看错颜色'后不当成羞耻或怪癖，而是登记为数据——异常的第一反应决定它是缺陷还是课题
从'我'推广到'我们'：查兄弟、查家族谱系，确认异常的非孤立性与遗传性——私人病例只有变成样本才有科学资格
给现象命名并公开病例：1794 年论文以'事实'为题而非'猜想'——命名使现象可以独立于研究者而流通
为验证付出终身代价：立遗嘱要求解剖自己的眼睛——用自己的一生为假设背书，死了也要把实验做完
process_en: Admit the anomaly instead of hiding it: finding he 'misread colors,' he registered it as data, not shame or quirk — the first response to an anomaly decides whether it is a defect or a topic
Extend from 'I' to 'we': check the brother, check the pedigree, establish the anomaly is neither solitary nor random — a private case earns scientific standing only as a sample
Name the phenomenon and publish the cases: the 1794 paper titled 'facts,' not conjectures — a name lets the phenomenon circulate independent of its discoverer
Pay a lifetime for verification: he willed his own eyes to dissection — staking a whole life on the hypothesis, finishing the experiment after death
representative_cases_zh: 1794 年《关于颜色知觉的非凡事实》：以自己与兄弟为首发病例、以曼彻斯特公众为对照样本——色盲作为科学对象诞生
家族遗传链调查：追溯母系亲属中同样的色觉异常——比现代遗传学早半个多世纪指出其遗传性
遗嘱解剖与 1995 年 DNA 复检：死后取出的眼睛证明其'眼内蓝色液体'假说错误，而 DNA 证实其为绿色盲——个人假设失败，科学问题长存
representative_cases_en: Extraordinary Facts Relating to the Vision of Colours (1794): himself and his brother as the index cases, the Manchester public as controls — color blindness born as an object of science
The pedigree of inheritance: tracing the same anomaly through the maternal line — pointing to heredity more than half a century ahead of modern genetics

The willed dissection and the 1995 DNA test: the eye taken after death disproving his 'blue fluid' hypothesis, while DNA confirmed deuteranopia — the private hypothesis failed; the scientific question endured
modern_applications_zh: '把自己当第一号实验品'：产品经理/研究者遇到自身的不适应（看不懂某界面、用不惯某流程）时，先登记为数据而非自我修正——你的障碍可能是千百万人的障碍
从个例到谱系：个人发现先找'还有谁也这样'（家族、用户群、历史记录），确认分布规律再立项——孤立轶事不成研究
命名即占有：给现象起可流通的名字（自己的名字也行）——命名的现象才能被引用、被搜索、被积累
modern_applications_en: Make yourself specimen number one: when a product manager or researcher finds some interface or flow strange to them, log it as data before fixing themselves — your obstacle may be that of millions
From case to pedigree: before starting a project, find who else shares it — families, user groups, archives — and confirm the distribution; an isolated anecdote is not a study
To name is to own: give the phenomenon a circulating name — only a named phenomenon can be cited, searched and accumulated

modes.name_en: The Method of Landing an Old Idea on Numbers
modes.domain_zh: '万物由原子构成'是留基伯、德谟克利特两千年前就提出的思辨，一直停在'哲学上说得通'——道尔顿做的事不是发明原子，而是给原子发身份证：以气体分压、化合物组成比例等可称可量的实验事实反推'原子必须有哪些性质才能解释这些数字'，并给每种元素指定相对原子量——哲学概念第一次获得可检验的数值身份；道尔顿证明：新科学的诞生常常不是新想法，而是旧想法拿到了自己的度量衡
modes.domain_en: 'All things are made of atoms' — a speculation left by Leucippus and Democritus two millennia earlier, still at the stage of 'philosophically plausible'; Dalton's work was not to invent the atom but to issue it papers: inferring from weighable, countable experimental facts — gas partial pressures, the proportions of compounds — what properties atoms must have to explain the numbers, and assigning each element a relative atomic weight; for the first time the philosophical concept gained a testable numerical identity; Dalton proved that a new science is often born not of new ideas but of old ideas getting their own weights and measures
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿 1787 年起做气象观测、终身记录（每日一条，直至去世前一天，共约 20 万条）；1800 年任曼彻斯特文学与哲学学会秘书后研究气体：1801 年提出分压定律（混合气体的总压为各组分分压之和）、1802 年前后提出膨胀定律；1803 年 12 月在爱丁堡宣读首次原子量表；1805 年发表化学哲学新体系的首批成果：以氢=1 为基准的相对原子量表（氢、氧、氮、碳、硫、磷等约 20 种）；1808 年出版《化学哲学新体系》第一卷，系统阐述原子学说：元素由同种原子构成、化合物由固定比例的原子结合、化学反应只是原子的重新组合——这些都不是新猜想，而是让两千年的原子论第一次接受数字检验
modes.key_quote_zh: 德谟克利特猜了两千年——我给他的原子称了重量
modes.key_quote_en: "Democritus guessed for two thousand years; I put his atoms on the scale."
process_zh: 清点旧概念欠下的账：原子论两千年来解释了'世界像什么'却从未解释过任何一个具体数字——找它'应能解释却从未解释'的现象清单
选最简单的可测现象入手：从气体（同种粒子最纯的系统）与定比化合物（组成比例恒定）出发——最简单的系统里概念才不掺杂质
让概念'必须'给出数值：若化合物由固定个数的原子组成，则各元素重量比应恒定——概念被逼着产出可核对的数字
以数字为概念建档：相对原子量表就是原子论的'户口本'——此后每个新实验都在为或为它添页，或为它订正
process_en: Audit what the old concept owes: atomism explained what the world is like but never a single concrete number — list what it should explain and never has
Start from the simplest measurable phenomena: gases (the purest system of like particles) and fixed-proportion compounds — in the simplest systems concepts admit least impurity
Force the concept to yield numbers: if compounds are fixed numbers of atoms, elemental weight ratios must be constant — the concept compelled to issue checkable figures
Archive the concept in numbers: the table of relative atomic weights as atomism's registry — every later experiment either adds pages or makes corrections
representative_cases_zh: 1803 年首张相对原子量表（以氢=1）：氢、氧、氮、碳等约 20 种元素第一次拥有可传递的数值身份——元素周期表的远祖
分压定律（1801）：混合气体各自独立压强、总压为其和——'气体由互不干扰的粒子构成'从图像变成定律
《化学哲学新体系》（1808）:原子学说以'元素-原子-化合物'三层结构系统出版——两百年的思辨获得教科书式的可检验形态
representative_cases_en: The first table of relative atomic weights (1803, hydrogen = 1): hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, carbon and some twenty elements gaining a transferable numerical identity — remote ancestor of the periodic table
The law of partial pressures (1801): each gas in a mixture pressing on its own, the total their sum — 'gases are crowds of non-interfering particles' turned from picture into law
A New System of Chemical Philosophy (1808): atomism published systematically in three layers, element, atom, compound — two millennia of speculation given a textbook-testable form
modern_applications_zh: 接手'人人都信但没人量化'的概念（'用户体验'、'团队士气'、'技术债'）时：先问'它若为真，哪些数字应当变化'——给旧概念找度量衡比另起新概念更有价值
从最简单的系统入手定量：不要在所有场景同时验证一个概念，先找它的'气体'（变量最少、最纯的场景）
让概念'被数字逼供'：写下'若概念为真则 X 应等于多少'——答不出的概念尚未成为科学
modern_applications_en: Take over a concept everyone believes but no one has quantified — user experience, morale, technical debt: first ask 'if true, which numbers should move'; giving an old concept its measures beats minting new ones
Quantify from the simplest system: do not test a concept everywhere at once; find its 'gas' — the purest, least-variable scenario
Put the concept on the numerical rack: write down 'if true, X should equal what' — a concept that cannot answer is not yet science

modes.name_en: The Method of the Twenty-Year Weather Ledger
modes.category: 认知方法/长期记录打底
modes.domain_zh: 他从 21 岁起每天记录气象，直到去世前一天——约五十七年、二十万条，从未间断；原子论不是灵光一现，而是从这份'无聊'的台账里长出来的：对大气成分与水汽的长期测量使他追问'气体为什么能混合'、'水汽为什么有上限'——没有大问题的年代，就把观测本身做成大问题的存款；道尔顿证明：重大理论的地基常是一份没人愿意做的枯燥记录
modes.domain_en: From twenty-one he kept a weather log every day until the day before he died — some fifty-seven years, some two hundred thousand entries, unbroken; atomic theory was not a flash but grew out of this 'dull' ledger: long measurement of atmosphere and vapor made him ask why gases mix and why vapor has a limit; in years when no great question offers, make the observation itself the deposit for one; Dalton proved that the foundation of a great theory is often a tedious record no one else will keep
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿 1787 年（21 岁）在肯德尔开始每日气象记录，1793 年迁曼彻斯特后继续，直至 1844 年 7 月 26 日（去世前一天）写下最后一条，累计约 20 万条观测——后世称之为史上最长的人工气象连续记录之一；从这份记录中他发展出对大气组成（氮、氧、水汽、二氧化碳）的兴趣，1801 年由此提出分压定律；1802 年他独立发表'蒸发'研究，指出水汽在真空中与在大气中同样自由蒸发——这正是'气体粒子互不干扰'的最早证据链；1826 年皇家学会授予其皇家奖章时，表彰的理由首列就是气象观测与大气物理
modes.key_quote_zh: 今天的晴雨表读数——我又记了一天；五万七千个'今天'凑成了一个大问题
modes.key_quote_en: "Today's barometer — another day entered; fifty-seven thousand 'todays' grew into one great question."
process_zh: 把'无题'时期变成记录时期：没有大课题的年头，坚持记录手头可测的一切（气压、温度、销量、日志）——记录是理论的期权
保持格式恒定使数据可加总：每日一条、字段固定——可加总的数据才能复利
定期从台账里'提现'问题：水汽上限、气体混合这类大问题都是从气象数据里读出来的——账不是记完就睡，而是按期翻查
记录直到最后一天：去世前一日仍有读数——让数据的完整性成为研究者信誉的一部分
process_en: Turn the untitled years into recording years: with no great problem at hand, log everything measurable — records are options on future theory
Keep the format constant so data sums: one entry a day, fields fixed — only summable data compounds
Withdraw questions from the ledger on schedule: vapor's limit and the mixing of gases were read out of weather data — a ledger is not for sleeping on but for periodic audit
Record to the last day: a reading the day before he died — completeness of data as part of a researcher's credit
representative_cases_zh: 五十七年气象日志（1787-1844）：约 20 万条记录从未间断——原子论的分压定律直接从这份数据里生长出来
1802 年'蒸发'研究：从日志数据推出'水汽独立于大气压蒸发'——为'粒子互不干扰'提供最早的实验证据
1826 年皇家奖章：表彰理由首列气象观测——'无聊'的坚持被最高学术机构认证为第一等贡献
representative_cases_en: Fifty-seven years of weather records (1787-1844): some 200,000 unbroken entries — the law of partial pressures grew straight out of this dataset
The evaporation studies (1802): from the ledger, that vapor evaporates as freely against air as in vacuum — the earliest experimental evidence that particles do not hinder one another
The Royal Medal (1826): weather observation first among the citations — 'dull' persistence certified first-class by the highest scientific body
modern_applications_zh: 没有方向时先建台账：创业者/研究者在'不知道研究什么'的阶段，先建一条每日记录线（用户行为、个人精力、市场报价）——理论会在数据积累后自动显现
格式恒定重于内容精彩：宁可字段简单二十年不变，不要半年一改版——可加总性是数据复利的前提
定期'翻账提问题'：每季度重读自己的长期记录，寻找系统性的异常——问题是账本里长出来的，不是空想出来的
modern_applications_en: Keep a ledger when direction is lacking: in the phase of not knowing what to study, start one daily record — user behavior, energy, prices; theory shows itself after the data compounds
Constant format over brilliant content: prefer twenty years of simple fields to a redesign every half-year — summability is the precondition of compound interest
Audit the ledger for questions quarterly: reread your long series for systematic anomalies — problems grow out of accounts, not out of thin air

modes.name_en: The Method of the Law of Multiple Proportions
modes.category: 认知方法/从规律到结构
modes.domain_zh: 定比定律只说'化合物组成恒定'，道尔顿多问一层：同一两种元素若能组成不止一种化合物，其重量比之间有没有关系？——他实测一氧化碳与二氧化碳、甲烷与乙烯后发现：两元素化合的重量比例成简单整数比——这是人类第一次从实验数字里直接'看见'原子：只有'整颗整颗不可分的粒子'参与化合，整数比才必然成立；道尔顿证明：在已有定律旁多问一句'那两条定律放在一起说什么'，往往就是新物理学
modes.domain_en: The law of definite proportions says only that compound composition is constant; Dalton asked one more storey up: if the same two elements form more than one compound, how are the weight ratios related? — measuring carbon monoxide against carbon dioxide, methane against ethylene, he found the proportions standing in ratios of small whole numbers — the first time humanity 'saw' the atom in experimental numbers: only whole, indivisible particles entering combination make integer ratios necessary; Dalton proved that asking what two existing laws say together is often the beginning of new physics
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿 1803-1804 年系统检验'倍比定律'（law of multiple proportions）：普鲁斯特的定比定律（1800 年前后确立，与贝尔托莱的论战）说明化合物组成恒定；道尔顿追问'同二元素多种化合物间'的关系，以一氧化碳/二氧化碳（氧比 1:2）、甲烷/乙烯（碳氢比 2:1）等实测数据证明其重量比成简单整数比；这一整数性只有假设'元素由不可分的原子以整数个结合'才能自然解释——倍比定律因此成为原子学说最早的定量支柱；1808 年《化学哲学新体系》将其与原子量表并列为学说两翼
modes.key_quote_zh: 数字们自己排成了整数——那是原子在报名
modes.key_quote_en: "The numbers fell into whole figures of their own accord — that was the atoms signing the register."
process_zh: 给已有定律'加一层追问'：定比定律讲单种化合物恒定——追问'多种化合物之间'的关系是定律间的空隙
选成对的简单化合物实测：CO/CO2、CH4/C2H4 等一对对测——配对比较比孤立测量更能暴露结构
把配对数据摆成比例表：重量比 1:2、2:1、2:3——让整数性自己跳出来，而不是先有原子论再找数字
反推唯一能解释整数性的机制：粒子只能'整颗'参与——规律升格为结构证据，原子论从哲学变成必需品
process_en: Add one storey to an existing law: definite proportions covers single compounds — ask after relations among several; the seam between laws is unmined
Measure paired simple compounds: CO against CO2, CH4 against C2H4 — paired comparison exposes structure that isolated measurement hides
Lay the pairs out as a ratio table: 1:2, 2:1, 2:3 — let the integrality jump out on its own, rather than finding numbers for a prior atomism
Infer the one mechanism that explains integrality: particles joining only whole — the law promoted to structural evidence, atomism from philosophy to necessity
representative_cases_zh: 一氧化碳与二氧化碳的氧比 1:2：同一碳与不同量氧——整数比成为'整颗原子'的直接签名
甲烷与乙烯的碳氢比对照：两组化合物、同一整数逻辑——倍比定律不是孤例而是系列
1808 年《化学哲学新体系》：倍比定律+原子量表双支柱——原子学说第一次拿到自己的定量地基
representative_cases_en: The oxygen ratio 1:2 in CO and CO2: one carbon, two amounts of oxygen — the integer ratio as the direct signature of whole atoms
The CH4/C2H4 comparison: two compounds, one integer logic — multiple proportions a series, not an isolated case
A New System of Chemical Philosophy (1808): multiple proportions and the atomic weights as twin pillars — atomism's first quantitative foundation
modern_applications_zh: 在两条定律/指标之间找'缝隙问题'：转化率稳定与客单价稳定各自成立——问'同一用户先后两次消费的比值有没有结构'，可能直接看见'整颗用户'
配对比较优于孤立测量：A/B 测试、竞品对照、前后版本对比——结构只在'成对'中显形
让机制从数据中'被迫'出现：先呈现比例/分布的反常整齐，再问'什么样的机制必然产生这种整齐'——机制是必需品而非装饰
modern_applications_en: Mine the seam between two laws or metrics: conversion stable and basket stable each alone — ask whether the ratio between a user's successive purchases has structure, and you may see the 'whole user'
Paired comparison beats isolated measurement: A/B tests, competitor pairs, version against version — structure shows itself in pairs
Let mechanism be forced out by the data: show the too-neat ratio first, then ask what mechanism must produce such neatness — mechanism as necessity, not ornament

modes.name_en: The Method of Assuming the Greatest Simplicity
modes.domain_zh: 知道'整数比'还不够——水是 H2O 还是 HO？相对原子量取决于分子式，而当时没有任何实验能直接数出分子里的原子个数；道尔顿立了一条工作假设：'若两元素只成一种化合物，取最简比 1:1；若成两种，取 1:2 或 1:3'——他自知这是假设而非事实，坦然标注；由此推出氧=8（现代值 16，因水实为 H2O）——错了一倍，但定量化学由这条'大胆的最简假设'起步，后世拉维特、坎尼扎罗用阿伏伽德罗定律修正它；道尔顿证明：在无据可依处，与其不表态，不如立一条明示的、可被推翻的规则把科学推着先走
modes.domain_en: Whole numbers were not enough — is water HO or H2O? Relative atomic weights depend on formulas, and no experiment of the day could count the atoms in a molecule; Dalton set a working assumption: one compound only, take 1:1; two compounds, take 1:2 or 1:3 — knowing it was an assumption, he said so plainly; hence oxygen = 8 (modern 16, water being H2O) — wrong by a factor, yet quantitative chemistry started from this bold simplicity rule, later corrected by Avogadro's law through Avogadro and Cannizzaro; Dalton proved that where no evidence exists, a stated, falsifiable rule that moves science forward beats abstaining
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿制定相对原子量时面临'分子式不确定'的根本困难：气体分析只能给出重量比，无法给出原子个数比；他采用'最大简比原则'（rule of greatest simplicity）：两元素只形成一种已知化合物时设其原子比为 1:1，两种则设 1:2 与 1:3……据此水被定为 HO、氧原子量为 8（以氢=1）；1808 年盖-吕萨克气体化合体积定律与 1811 年阿伏伽德罗假说提供了独立定分子式的路径，但道尔顿终生未接受阿伏伽德罗假说；1858-1860 年坎尼扎罗以之重定原子量，水的分子式确认为 H2O、氧=16——道尔顿的简比假设被系统修正，但'先假设、后修正'的路线被证明是正确的战略
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有别的证据时，取最简——并把它标成'假设'，等更好的证据来推翻
modes.key_quote_en: "Where no other evidence stands, take the simplest — and label it an assumption, waiting for better evidence to overturn it."
process_zh: 识别'必须表态但证据不足'的点：原子量表不能空着，而分子式又无法直接观测——科学不是所有问题都有现成证据
立一条明示的简化规则：'取最简整数比'——规则要简单到任何人可复用、可检验
把假设的身份写在成果上：以'假设'标签发表而非冒充结论——后来者知道该往哪里用力
欢迎修正并视其为路线成功：氧从 8 修到 16 不是失败，而是'先定量再修正'战略的兑现——有数值才谈得上修正
process_en: Spot the points where one must speak with insufficient evidence: the table could not stand empty, and formulas could not be seen — not every question comes with evidence ready
Set one explicit simplifying rule: 'take the simplest whole ratio' — simple enough for anyone to reuse and to test
Publish the assumption as an assumption: labeled, not dressed as conclusion — so successors know where to press
Welcome correction as the route's success: oxygen from 8 to 16 not a failure but the payoff of 'quantify first, revise later' — without numbers there is nothing to correct
representative_cases_zh: 水=HO、氧=8 的首版定标：分子式不可见时以简比规则先行——原子量表得以建立，尽管数值待修
终生拒纳阿伏伽德罗假说的'固执'：他有自觉的方法论边界（他只信重量比）——提示假设体系要写明适用域
坎尼扎罗 1860 年重定原子量：以阿伏伽德罗定律系统修正——道尔顿'先定量后修正'路线的完成式
representative_cases_en: Water as HO, oxygen as 8: with formulas invisible, the simplicity rule carried the day — the atomic table stood, values pending
A lifetime refusing Avogadro's hypothesis: a conscious methodological boundary (he trusted weight ratios only) — a reminder to state the domain of one's assumptions
Cannizzaro's redetermination (1860): Avogadro's law systematically correcting the table — Dalton's quantify-first route brought to completion
modern_applications_zh: 指标体系冷启动时的'简比规则'：定义新指标（如'活跃'、'优质内容'）没有黄金标准时，先取最简可复用的定义并公开标注'待修正'——先让体系跑起来
把假设写在产出物首页：报告、模型、定价表里明示哪一条是假设——团队才知道该验证什么
修正不是打脸而是兑现：数值/口径随证据升级时大张旗鼓地更新版本——'可修正'本身是方法资产的证明
modern_applications_en: A simplicity rule for cold-start metrics: with no gold standard for a new metric — active, quality content — take the simplest reusable definition, label it pending revision, and let the system run
Write assumptions on the front page: in reports, models and price lists, say which line is an assumption — so the team knows what to verify
Correction as payoff, not face-loss: update versions loudly as evidence upgrades — revisability is itself proof of method assets

modes.name_en: The Method of the Learned Society as One's Home
modes.category: 方法论/体制外的学术生存
modes.domain_zh: 他一生没有大学教授职位，也几乎没有接受过正式大学教育——曼彻斯特文学与哲学学会（Lit & Phil）就是他的大学、实验室与出版社：从 1793 年加入直至 1844 年去世，他在学会宣读了 116 篇论文，从色盲到原子论全在这里首发；不进体制核心，就把一个地方性学会经营成自己的制度支点——以稳定的输出换取学术共同体的持续在场；道尔顿证明：在体制外做出一流工作的人，需要先为自己发明一个'体制'
modes.domain_en: He held no university professorship and almost no formal university education; the Manchester Literary and Philosophical Society was his university, laboratory and press: from joining in 1793 to his death in 1844 he read 116 papers there, from color blindness to atomism all first given in that room; excluded from the institutional core, he ran a provincial society as his institutional fulcrum — steady output traded for continuous standing in the republic of science; Dalton proved that the outsider doing first-rate work must first invent an institution for himself
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿出身贵格会家庭，因教规不得进入牛津剑桥，毕业于贵格会创办的新学院（实际主要靠自学）；1793 年经约翰·高夫推荐任曼彻斯特新学院数学与自然哲学教师，同年加入曼彻斯特文学与哲学学会——1800 年任学会秘书，1808-1817 任副会长，1817 年起任会长直至去世；116 篇论文中包括色盲研究（1794）、分压定律（1801-1802）、原子学说首批成果（1803-1805）；他拒绝伦敦皇家学会等更大机构的多次邀请，坚守曼彻斯特；1822 年在未通知本人的情况下被选为皇家学会会员，1826 年获首届皇家奖章，1830 年入选法国科学院外籍院士——地方学会的'小舞台'被他经营成世界科学的'大据点'
modes.key_quote_zh: 伦敦没有我的讲台——曼彻斯特学会的屋子就够了，我一站在那里就是五十年
modes.key_quote_en: "London has no desk for me; the Manchester society's room sufficed — I stood there for fifty years."
process_zh: 把'进不了体制'转化为'不欠体制'：贵格会教规把他挡在牛津剑桥之外——他转身把省城学会当主场，免去体制的全部评审与站队成本
选定一个'屋子'就长期扎根：不追逐首都与头衔，五十年在同一学会持续宣读论文——在场本身就是资历
以输出节律而非职位晋升立身：116 篇论文的宣读记录就是他的履历——把'产线'（每次宣读）当作制度性存在
让外围荣誉自然回流：皇家学会会员、皇家奖章、法国院士都在不迁就的情况下到来——据点稳固后，中心会来连接据点
process_en: Convert exclusion from the establishment into owing it nothing: Quaker rules shut Oxford and Cambridge; he made a provincial society his home ground, free of all its review and faction costs
Root long in one chosen room: no chasing capitals and titles — fifty years reading papers in one society; presence itself is seniority
Stand on an output cadence, not a ladder of posts: 116 papers read, his résumé the reading list — the production line itself institutional
Let the outer honors flow back unasked: FRS, the Royal Medal, foreign membership of the French Academy, all without bending — the center connects to a firm node
representative_cases_zh: 曼彻斯特 Lit & Phil 五十年（1793-1844）：从会员到终身会长——116 篇论文首发于此，原子论诞生于省城学会的会议室
拒绝迁往伦敦：终生留在曼彻斯特以教课与私授化学谋生——不为头衔支付迁移成本
1822 年皇家学会'不告而选'：从未申请、未被通知即当选——体制外的持续输出使体制不得不追认
representative_cases_en: Fifty years in the Manchester Lit & Phil (1793-1844): member to lifelong president — 116 papers first read there, atomism born in a provincial meeting room
Refusing to move to London: a lifetime in Manchester, living by teaching and private pupils — never paying relocation costs for a title
Elected FRS unawares (1822): never applied, never notified — sustained output from outside compelling the establishment's retroactive welcome
modern_applications_zh: 在体制外工作的人先建'自己的学会'：个人开发者/独立研究者固定在一个社群长期输出（开源项目、固定专栏、月度分享）——在场与节律比头衔更能积累信用
以输出节律代替职位阶梯：不看'升到哪一级'而看'每周/每月产出了什么'——产线即履历
不为中心支付迁移成本：若中心认可你，荣誉会流向你的据点；据点不稳时迁去中心只是换地方漂泊
modern_applications_en: Outsiders must first found their own society: the independent developer or researcher picks one community and outputs there for years — an open project, a fixed column, a monthly talk; presence and cadence beat titles
Output cadence instead of a career ladder: not which rung but what shipped weekly or monthly — the production line is the résumé
Pay the center no relocation costs: if the center rates you, honors flow to your node; an unstable node merely drifts elsewhere
modes.definition_zh: 他一生没有大学教授职位，也几乎没有接受过正式大学教育——曼彻斯特文学与哲学学会（Lit & Phil）就是他的大学、实验室与出版社：从 1793 年加入直至 1844 年去世，他在学会宣读了 116 篇论文，从色盲到原子论全在这里首发；不进体制核心，就把一个地方性学会经营成自己的制度支点——以稳定的输出换取学术共同体的持续在场；道尔顿证明：在体制外做出一流工作的人，需要先为自己发明一个'体制'
modes.definition_en: He held no university professorship and almost no formal university education; the Manchester Literary and Philosophical Society was his university, laboratory and press: from joining in 1793 to his death in 1844 he read 116 papers there, from color blindness to atomism all first given in that room; excluded from the institutional core, he ran a provincial society as his institutional fulcrum — steady output traded for continuous standing in the republic of science; Dalton proved that the outsider doing first-rate work must first invent an institution for himself

modes.name_en: The Method of Settling Disputes with Ratios
modes.domain_zh: 当时法国化学权威贝托莱主张化合物组成可以随制备条件连续变化（如溶液、合金）——普鲁斯特以定比定律抗辩多年而胜负未决；道尔顿的贡献是给出裁决的底层逻辑：若化合物由整颗原子构成，则纯化合物的组成必然恒定、必然是整数比——连续变化只属于混合物而非化合物；争论从'谁观察得更仔细'变成'哪种机制能解释全部观察'——道尔顿证明：旷日持久的定性之争，往往要在引入一个'强制出整数'的机制后才能终结
modes.domain_en: The French authority Berthollet held that compound composition could vary continuously with conditions of preparation — solutions, alloys; Proust resisted for years with the law of definite proportions and the fight stalled; Dalton supplied the deep logic of the verdict: if compounds are built of whole atoms, a pure compound's composition must be constant and in whole-number ratio — continuous variation belongs to mixtures, not compounds; the dispute turned from 'who observed more carefully' to 'which mechanism explains all observations'; Dalton proved that long qualitative quarrels often end only when a mechanism that forces integers enters
modes.source_chapter: 定比定律之争：贝托莱 1803 年《化学静力学》主张亲和力随物质浓度变化、因而化合物组成可变，并以溶液、玻璃、合金为据；普鲁斯特 1797-1808 年以铜、锡、铁的多种氧化物与硫化物系列实验反驳，坚持'化合物有固定组成'；道尔顿原子论（1803-1808）提供了判决机制：化合物=整数个原子结合，其组成必然恒定成比；而组成可变的样品（溶液、合金、固溶体）实为混合物——1860 年前后以坎尼扎罗体系与化合物-混合物概念的标准划界尘埃落定；道尔顿把普鲁斯特的经验规律升格为原子论的必然推论
modes.key_quote_zh: 别再争谁的眼睛更准——先问哪一种机制能让数字必然如此
modes.key_quote_en: "Stop quarrelling over whose eyes are truer — ask first which mechanism makes the numbers necessary."
process_zh: 把'观察之SKI争'升格为'机制之辩'：双方数据都能成立时，问题不在眼睛而在'什么结构能同时解释全部数据'
为争议对象划本体论界线：化合物与混合物被原子论分开——连续可变的被归入混合物，恒定整比的才是化合物
让机制给出必然性而非大概性：整颗原子的结合'必然'给出恒定整比——从'通常如此'升级为'必然如此'的定律才算赢
保留对方阵营的真实现象：溶液与合金的连续变化没有被否认，而是被重新归位——裁决不是消灭对手而是给现象安家
process_en: Promote the quarrel from eyesight to mechanism: when both sides' data stand, the question is not whose eyes but what structure explains all data together
Draw the ontological line for the disputed objects: atomism divides compound from mixture — the continuously variable assigned to mixtures, the constant whole-number ratios alone to compounds
Let the mechanism give necessity, not likelihood: whole atoms combining must yield constant integral ratios — a law wins only when 'usually so' becomes 'necessarily so'
Keep the opponent's real phenomena: solutions and alloys not denied but rehomed — a verdict as resettlement of phenomena, not annihilation of rivals
representative_cases_zh: 贝托莱-普鲁斯特-道尔顿三级论战链：连续组成说→定比经验律→原子必然整比——每一级都把争论的地基挖深一层
溶液/合金的'再归位'：组成可变的样品没有被丢弃，而是被划入混合物——正确裁决让反例变成支持证据
1860 年坎尼扎罗体系收尾：原子量与分子式的统一标准使化合物-混合物划界成为教科书共识——三十余年的争论以机制取胜而非以嗓门取胜
representative_cases_en: The three-stage chain Berthollet, Proust, Dalton: continuous composition, then the empirical law, then atomic necessity — each stage digging the dispute's foundations deeper
Rehoming solutions and alloys: the variable samples not discarded but assigned to mixtures — a correct verdict turning counterexamples into supporting evidence
Cannizzaro's system closing the quarrel (c. 1860): unified standards for weights and formulas making the compound-mixture boundary textbook consensus — thirty years ended by mechanism, not volume
modern_applications_zh: 团队长期争执的'机制升级法'：双方数据都成立时（转化率、留存各说各话），先约定'什么结构/模型能同时解释双方数据'，再回到数据——把嗓门之争变成建模之争
给争议概念划'本体论界线'：'这是bug还是需求'、'这是投资还是费用'——先定义两类现象的判据，个案争议自动消解大半
赢的标准是'反例被归位'而非'反例被消灭'：对手的例外现象若能被你的机制重新解释，你的胜利才稳固
modern_applications_en: Upgrade team disputes to mechanism: when both sides' metrics stand, agree first on what structure or model explains both datasets together, then return to data — from volume to modeling
Draw ontological lines for disputed terms: bug or feature, investment or expense — define criteria for the two kinds and most case quarrels dissolve
Win by rehoming counterexamples, not killing them: if your mechanism re-explains the other side's exceptions, your victory is stable

modes.name_en: The Method of Teaching to Feed Research
modes.category: 方法论/职业与研究共生
modes.domain_zh: 他一生靠教书与私授谋生：在肯德尔教书、在曼彻斯特讲数学与自然哲学、收费私授化学——教学不是研究的对立面，而是它的现金流与回音壁：把同样的原理对普通学生讲明白，就是对原理最严格的清晰度测试；他对'给学徒和工程师讲课'的重视，直接练出了《化学哲学新体系》那种把抽象原理讲成可操作规则的文风；道尔顿证明：谋生技能与研究事业可以设计成互相供血，而非互相争夺
modes.domain_en: All his life he lived by teaching: schoolmaster at Kendal, lecturer in mathematics and natural philosophy in Manchester, paid private pupils in chemistry — teaching not the rival of research but its cash flow and sounding board: to explain a principle to ordinary students is the strictest test of its clarity; the attention he paid to lecturing apprentices and engineers trained the style of the New System, abstract principle turned operational rule; Dalton proved that the day job and the life's work can be designed to feed each other rather than to compete
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿 15 岁起在肯德尔贵格会学校随兄长任教，1785 年兄长退休后主持校务；1793 年迁曼彻斯特任新学院数学与自然哲学教师，因学院 1799 年迁址等原因转为私授：长期招收私人学生讲授化学与数学，同时担任曼彻斯特 Lit & Phil 学会秘书并作公开讲演——他终身以教学与讲演收入维持研究，从未任大学教授；他善于把高深原理向非专业听众讲清（气象、气体、原子论都先在学会公开讲演中打磨）；这种'讲课即初稿'的习惯使其著作以清晰规整著称
modes.key_quote_zh: 对我解释不清的地方，就是我自己还没懂的地方——学生是我的第一读者和第一审稿人
modes.key_quote_en: "What I cannot explain plainly is what I do not yet understand — my students are my first readers and first referees."
process_zh: 把谋生技能设计成研究的'低损耗相邻物'：他教的自然哲学/化学与研究对象几乎同域——讲课材料与研究材料互通，准备一次课即推进一稿
以'讲得懂'为清晰度的硬标准：面对普通学生与学徒讲课——抽象原理被迫转成可操作规则，这是最好的写作训练
用讲课的固定节奏给研究供血：白天授课收入稳定、夜晚研究 uninterrupted——现金流不与研究抢时间，而为研究买时间
把听众当第一审稿人：学会公开讲演先于论文发表——最难缠的问题都在现场出现过，论文只是把答辩写下来
process_en: Design the day job as research's low-loss neighbor: he taught the very field he researched — lecture materials and research materials one pool; preparing a class advancing a draft
Make 'can be explained' the hard test of clarity: ordinary students and apprentices forced abstraction into operational rules — the best training in writing
Let a fixed teaching rhythm feed research: daytime income steady, nights uninterrupted — the cash flow not competing for time but buying it
Treat the audience as first referees: public lectures before papers — the nastiest questions met in the room, the paper only the written defense
representative_cases_zh: 肯德尔贵格会学校十二年：边教书边开始气象记录——谋生岗位即研究起点
曼彻斯特私授化学数十年：以学费供养研究，从未任教授——'独立学者'的经济模型被一个人运转了一辈子
学会公开讲演先于发表：原子论首批成果 1803 年先在学会讲演中亮相——讲台成为论文的预演场
representative_cases_en: Twelve years in the Kendal Quaker school: teaching while starting the weather log — the day job as the research's starting line
Decades of private pupils in Manchester: fees funding research, never a professor — the independent scholar's economic model run by one man for a lifetime
Society lectures before publication: the first atomic results read to the society in 1803 — the lectern as the paper's dress rehearsal
modern_applications_zh: 把'谋生技能'选在研究隔壁：接与研究方向相通的咨询/教学/工程活——做一单活同时积累一份数据与一稿素材，而非两套消耗
以'讲给外行听懂'为检验：内部方法先讲给客户或学生——讲不清的地方就是没想清的地方
固定输出节奏供养长线研究：白天接活、夜间研究、季度发一篇公开讲演/文章——用现金流买研究时间而不是透支它
modern_applications_en: Pick the day job next door to research: consulting, teaching or engineering in the same field — one engagement yields both a fee and a draft, not double consumption
Test with 'explain it to a layman': present internal methods to clients or students first; what cannot be explained is not yet understood
Feed long-line research with a fixed output rhythm: engagements by day, research by night, a public talk or paper each quarter — buying research time with cash flow, not overdrafting it

modes.name_en: The Method of Plain Living Guarding the Agenda
modes.category: 个人品格/简朴与议程自主
modes.domain_zh: 贵格会教规给了他一身灰衣与一整套生活纪律：不追逐头衔、不做浮华社交、需要时甚至拒绝宣誓（因此一度无法领受皇家奖章的正式授予仪式）——简朴不是苦行表演，而是议程保护装置：低物欲使他不依赖恩主的偏好， refuses 使他的日程表里只有气象、学会与讲台；他拒绝很多镀金机会，也拒绝把研究包装成表演；道尔顿证明：清苦的生活方式可以是最强硬的谈判立场——我不需要，所以我的方向不被购买
modes.domain_en: Quaker discipline gave him grey clothes and a whole rule of life: no chasing titles, no showy society, and at need refusal even of oaths (which long kept him from formally receiving the Royal Medal); plainness not as ascetic display but as agenda armor: low wants freed him from dependence on patrons' tastes, and refusal kept his calendar holding only weather, society and lectern; he declined gilded opportunities and refused to package research as performance; Dalton proved that a frugal life can be the hardest bargaining position — I need nothing, so my direction is not for sale
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿终身为贵格会（公谊会）信徒：着灰衣、言辞简素、拒绝浮华与誓愿——贵格会教规使他不得进入牛津剑桥（均要求宗教宣誓），也使他 1826 年接受皇家奖章时因拒誓产生程序波折（后以贵格会的'确认'方式完成）；他拒绝多次为其安排的隆重庆典（晚年皇家学会与学界为他举行的宴会亦从简），终生未婚、生活极简，逝世时留下不多的遗产；他拒绝担任伦敦的显赫教职与行政职务，坚持留在曼彻斯特以教学为生——经济上的无求与教规上的自律共同构成其研究议程的独立保障
modes.key_quote_zh: 灰衣是我最好的铠甲——无所求的人，方向才真正属于自己
modes.key_quote_en: "The grey coat is my best armor — the one who needs nothing truly owns his direction."
process_zh: 把生活方式设计成'低依赖系统'：终身未婚、简衣简食、不留俗世浮名——需求越少，能被购买的把手越少
以教规/信条为'拒绝'的外骨骼：拒绝宣誓、拒绝庆典不是个人任性而是共同体的明规则——用规则拒绝比用性格拒绝成本更低
把头衔当成'顺便的'而非'目标的'：皇家奖章、法国院士都接受但不迁就——荣誉是输出的事后利率，不是输出的方向盘
用省下的物欲换研究议程的完整：不接镀金职务、不做表演性社交——日历上只留气象、学会与讲台
process_en: Design the way of life as a low-dependence system: unmarried, plainly dressed, no worldly show — the fewer the wants, the fewer the handles by which one can be bought
Use a creed as the exoskeleton of refusal: declining oaths and banquets as the community's plain rule, not personal caprice — refusing by rule costs less than refusing by temperament
Treat honors as incidental, never as aims: the Royal Medal and French membership accepted without bending — honor the after-interest of output, not its steering wheel
Trade saved appetite for an intact agenda: no gilded posts, no performative society — the calendar keeping only weather, society and lectern
representative_cases_zh: 拒誓与皇家奖章风波（1826）：因贵格教规拒绝宣誓，奖章授予仪式一度受阻——为信条支付程序代价也在所不惜
拒绝牛津剑桥与显赫教职：宗教门槛把他挡在门外，他反把门槛变成不欠体制的理由——外在限制被转译为议程自主
简朴终老：终生未婚、积蓄不多、临终前仍在记录气象——低消耗的一生换来了五十七年不间断的研究线
representative_cases_en: The oath and the Royal Medal (1826): Quaker rule refusing the oath, the ceremony long delayed — paying a procedural price for creed without flinching
Oxford, Cambridge and grand posts declined: the religious bar shut out, he turned the bar into freedom from obligation — external limit translated into agenda autonomy
Frugal to the end: unmarried, modest savings, still recording weather days before death — a low-consumption life buying fifty-seven unbroken years of research
modern_applications_zh: '低物欲'作为职业谈判资产：储蓄率高、生活半径小的研究者/创业者可以拒绝更多坏合同——'我不需要'是最强的议价筹码
把拒绝规则化：给自己立明文拒绝清单（不接什么类别的活、不参加什么形式的会）——用规则拒绝省去每一次的说服成本
荣誉收下但不开方向盘：接受奖项与认可，但让它们只进入履历而不进入日程——议程的完整高于荣誉的增值
modern_applications_en: Low wants as negotiating assets: the researcher or founder with high savings and a small radius can refuse more bad contracts — 'I need nothing' is the strongest chip
Rule-ize your refusals: a written list of what you decline — categories of work, forms of meetings; refusing by rule saves the cost of persuading each time
Take honors but never let them steer: accept awards as résumé entries, never as calendar entries; an intact agenda outranks appreciating honors

modes.name_en: The Method of Inventing One's Own Scientific Identity
modes.domain_zh: '化学家'这个职业在 1800 年前后尚未成型：没有化学系、没有职业资格、没有'科学家'一词（一词要到 1833 年才由休厄尔造出）——道尔顿织工之子、教书匠、贵格会徒，却用'每日气象记录+学会论文+私人授课'三件套把'科学家'这个身份在'职业'存在之前就过成了现实：不是先有身份再做事，而是用做事的方式把自己造成一种新身份的原型；他去世时曼彻斯特四万人致哀，一个'身份'在官方承认之前已被社会承认；道尔顿证明：新身份属于那些在制度为其命名之前就以制度化的方式行事的人
modes.domain_en: Around 1800 'chemist' was not yet a profession: no chemistry faculties, no credentials, not even the word 'scientist' (coined only in 1833 by Whewell); a weaver's son, schoolmaster and Quaker, Dalton lived the identity into being before the profession existed, with three instruments — the daily weather record, society papers, private teaching; not identity first and work after, but work in such form that it coined a new identity; when he died, forty thousand Mancunians lined the streets — an identity socially confirmed before official recognition; Dalton proved that new identities belong to those who act institutionally before institutions name them
modes.source_chapter: 道尔顿 1766 年生于坎伯兰伊格利斯菲尔德的织工家庭，几乎没有正规高等教育（贵格会学校并自学）；'科学家'（scientist）一词 1833 年才由威廉·休厄尔提出，此前通称'自然哲学家'；道尔顿以'气象记录者-学会论文作者-私人教师'三重日常实践构建了自己的职业身份：五十七年气象日志使其成为'观测者'，116 篇学会论文使其成为'作者'，数十年私授使其成为'教师'——三者在没有任何职业认证体系的情况下互相强化；1844 年去世时曼彻斯特约四万人参加葬礼（当时全城人口约 23 万），遗体被安放于市政厅供公众瞻仰——一个自造的身份获得了城市规模的社会承认；后世纪念：道尔顿原子量的单位'道尔顿'（Dalton, Da）成为分子量的通用单位
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有'化学家'这个职业？那就每天记录、每月宣读、每周授课——直到这个词不得不被发明出来
modes.key_quote_en: "No such profession as chemist? Then record daily, read monthly, teach weekly — until the word must be coined for what I already do."
process_zh: 在'职业'存在之前先'执业'：没有化学系就自组三件套（记录、发表、授课）——身份由日常实践的固定结构定义，而非由机构颁发
让三重实践互相强化：观测供数据、论文供声望、授课供现金流——自造身份要有内部循环，不能只靠单腿
以可见的规律性赢得社会承认：每日读数与每月宣读都是可被邻里见证的惯例——身份的建立靠'被看见的日常'而非自我宣称
接受身份被命名与被纪念：'道尔顿'成为分子量单位——自造的身份最终沉淀为公共基础设施
process_en: Practice before the profession exists: no chemistry faculty, so he assembled his own trio — record, publish, teach; identity defined by the fixed structure of daily practice, not conferred by institutions
Let the three practices reinforce one another: observation feeding data, papers feeding standing, teaching feeding cash — a self-made identity needs an internal loop, not one leg
Win social recognition by visible regularity: daily readings and monthly readings are customs neighbors can witness — identity built on a seen routine, not self-claim
Accept the identity's naming and commemoration: the dalton as unit of molecular mass — the self-made identity settling into public infrastructure
representative_cases_zh: 三件套身份工程（1787-1844）：气象日志+116 篇论文+数十年私授——在没有职业资格的年代活成一个'职业'
1844 年曼彻斯特市政厅瞻仰与四万人送葬：一个自造身份获得城市规模的社会承认——早于任何官方头衔
'道尔顿'成为分子量单位（Da）：名字沉淀为科学计量单位——身份自造的最高形态是成为公共计量标准
representative_cases_en: The trio identity project (1787-1844): weather log, 116 papers, decades of pupils — living as a profession before credentials existed
Lying in state at Manchester Town Hall and forty thousand mourners (1844): a self-made identity acknowledged at the scale of a city, before any official title
The dalton (Da) as unit of molecular mass: a name settled into scientific metrology — the highest form of self-made identity, becoming public standard
modern_applications_zh: 新职业（独立开发者、创作者、研究者）没有认证体系时：自组'三件套'日常结构（记录+公开发表+可收费服务）——用执业代替求职
让身份的内部循环转起来：产出喂声望、声望喂客户、客户喂现金流——单一变现路径撑不起自造身份
以可见的规律性取代自我宣称：'每天更新'与'每月公开'是邻里可见证的惯例——身份靠被看见的日常建立
modern_applications_en: Where new callings — indie developer, creator, researcher — have no credential, assemble the trio: record, publish openly, sell a service; practice instead of applying
Spin the identity's internal loop: output feeding standing, standing feeding clients, clients feeding cash — a single revenue path cannot hold up a self-made identity
Replace self-claim with visible regularity: daily updates and monthly public readings are witnessable customs — identity built on a seen routine
